# f5xc_app_setting (Data Source)

'App Setting' controls advanced monitoring of applications defined by 'App type'. This configuration is per namespace.<br>There is only one App Setting per namespace. It has list of references to 'App type' objects for which various<br>anomaly detection algorithms can be enabled.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: App Setting - Full

data "f5xc_app_setting" "example" {
  name      = f5xc_app_setting.example.name
  namespace = f5xc_app_setting.example.namespace
}
```

- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
